name: The R Apartments Studio

facts.text: Studio apartments on Jalan Pantai Pererenan for 2 to 4 guests (4 guests for the studio on the linked page, 2 for the studio 'Walk to the Beach').
Pool access (shared pool), a garden with outdoor seating and a private entrance.
facts.source: elevate-villas.com studio page ('Garden and Pool: shared pool')

facts.text: Air conditioning, TV, WiFi and hot water; a safe box, hair dryer and linens.
facts.source: elevate-villas.com studio page and Elev8 questionnaire

facts.text: Full kitchen with stove, microwave, blender, toaster, coffee maker, kettle, and a refrigerator with freezer.
Pererenan Beach is about 5 minutes on foot. Paid parking off premises.
